result.summary: Found 1 major layout issue where restaurant metadata text overlaps and becomes unreadable.

issues.description: Under the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' listing in the 'Popular right now' section, the delivery time ('25–35 min') and delivery fee ('€0 delivery') labels overlap directly on top of each other, making both illegible.
issues.suggestion: Use proper horizontal flex or inline spacing (with a separator dot like the one before 'Ramen') so the delivery time and delivery fee render side by side without overlapping.
